population.validation: 7 checks, 0 violations, 2 iterations closure (4 degenerate removed)
population.notes: Validated, mu approx 7.139, scripts 39/40 reuse, do NOT refit. All Step7/7B/7C evidence on this population, origin/main at 0ef6375.

quality_estimator.definition: mean(rating - delta_u) per game, mu+alpha+delta additive model
why_not_fold: adequate_overlap only 32.8% (4819/14698), borderline 44.2%, insufficient 23.0% — global correction not identified for 2/3
weighting magnitude 156x larger after correction: median max_w_true 1449 vs 9.3 sampled, p95 7619 p99 16566 max 65414
stabilized vs raw identical rank (corr 1.0), adj vs prop_adj Spearman 0.973 top100 Jaccard 0.626 — no estimator gain
truncation cap20 recovers ESS 0.33->0.98 but attenuates |delta|>=0.2 from 20.8% to 0.2% std 0.19->0.03
RF overconfident (AUC 0.849 but ECE 0.324) vs corrected logistic ECE 0.00034, Brier 0.00558 — model good for sensitivity not quality
quality_estimator.rater_type_interaction: joint rater x game-type taste v2: <1% variance (R2 0.393->0.403), no flag stable/distinct/material — do not add type correction
quality_estimator.interpretation_rule: do not claim self-selection solved; observable pool selectivity distinct from unobserved non-rater selection

audience_selection_role.role: screening / sensitivity dimension, NOT folded into core quality
audience_selection_role.carries_forward_7C: global severity-adjusted estimator remains appropriate — no fold-in
audience_selection_role.therefore: exposure propensity is hidden-gem screening / sensitivity flag

true_scale_rescaled_rule.justification: prevalence factor 87x = exp(5.159), marginal 0.00572; diagnostics: median max_w_true 1449 p95 7619, ESS_ratio median 0.33 p10 0.17, mean_p median 0.027 p30 0.015 p10 0.005

insufficient_overlap.condition: n_obs < 150 OR max_w_true > 8700 (100*87 scaled, p95~7619) OR ESS_ratio_true < 0.10 (p10) OR mean_p_true < 0.005 (~marginal)
insufficient_overlap.meaning: broader counterfactual not identified — unknown, not cult/bad

borderline_overlap.condition: not insufficient AND (max_w_true > 1740 (20*87, median 1449) OR ESS_ratio < 0.30 (median 0.33) OR mean_p_true < 0.015 (3*marginal, p30))

sampled_scale_reference.threshold_sample: n<150 or max_w>100 or ESS<0.10 or mean_p<0.001

true_scale_rescaled_rule.scaling_note: thresholds scaled from Step7B (100->8700, 20->1740) via 87x prevalence factor, not to improve output

stable_under_exposure_adjustment.definition: adequate_overlap and |delta_quality| < 0.20 and ESS>0.30 and max_w<1740

stable_exposure.gate_effect: PASS — eligible for hidden-gem candidacy, standard broad-appeal check

exposure_sensitive.CSV_mapping: borderline_overlap with moderately_sensitive or strongly_sensitive, OR adequate with |delta|>=0.20
exposure_sensitive.example_counts: moderate 4711 + strong 1588, borderline adequate with delta>=0.2
exposure_sensitive.interpretation: observable selection materially changes estimate, needs stronger cross-audience evidence
exposure_sensitive.gate_effect: DOWNGRADE to caution — requires >=2 splits n>=10 |diff|<0.30 non-significant AND |truncated_delta|<0.20 direction-consistent; else niche_but_high_quality
exposure_sensitive.why_not_exclude: 20.8% |delta|>=0.2 common, heterogeneous (18XX SD 0.67), some sensitive games still broad (e.g., 18Chesapeake diff 0.00)

insufficient_overlap.interpretation: broader counterfactual not identified (weights explode, ESS collapse)
insufficient_overlap.gate_effect: UNKNOWN — exclude from BGG-only hidden-gem claim; preserve for external validation; do not call cult/bad
insufficient_overlap.example: 1830 max_w 50707 ESS 0.12 delta -0.321 yet insufficient — sensitivity real but not identified

exposure_classes.primary_at_risk: TYPE_GE10 for typed, ACTIVE_50PLUS for Other, sensitivities ALL_ACTIVE and TYPE_GE20

primary_gates.why: only measure of reweighting toward broader plausible population; corr |delta| vs spec_ge20 0.38 leaves 62% unexplained, adds beyond threshold; gateway 1830 vs specialist 1817 continuous gradient beyond spec>=10

primary_gates.measure: 7 cross-audience diffs where n>=10 per side (specialist 0-4 vs >=20, volume 10-24 vs 500+)
primary_gates.why: only direct test does high quality remain among non-specialists/light raters; volume 9227 >=10 specialist 3973; median diff small (0.08 volume, 0.15 specialist) but some material

supporting.measure: 7 composition: spec_share_ge10/ge20, share_0_4/share_ge20, TVD_volume_type/global (same-type mean 0.152 most informative), herfindahl q75 0.203, share_within_0.5, share_own q75 0.664
supporting.why: describes who is in pool, corroborates which dimension drives narrowness; broad categories inflate spec mean 0.832 so read type-specific

supporting.measure: 7 penetration proxy among enthusiasts (penetration_ge20: median 18XX 0.297 vs Wargame 0.010 vs Party 0.007)
supporting.why: within-type selectivity diagnostic; exposure not negative

supporting.measure: 7C corroboration: ess_ratio, max_weight, mean_p, truncated_delta, mean_p_raters weighted

diagnostic_only: share_cat_or_mech_related, weight_missing 7, RF delta variation (rank corr 0.93, diff 0.03 but ECE 0.324)
per-game category penetration for Other not globally computed
primary_vs_secondary.ordering_flow: 7C overlap/ESS as GATE (identified?) -> 7 cross-audience as TEST (parity?) -> 7 composition/penetration as SUPPORTING narrative
primary_vs_secondary.justification: 7C determines if broader counterfactual identified at all; 7 cross-audience tests realized breadth; composition explains why narrow. Do not collapse into opaque score — different units/threshold sensitivities (e.g., Catan 0.50 spec moderate not low due to broad Economic).

QUALITY.question: Is genuinely good? (severity-adjusted)
QUALITY.measure: adj_mean from game_adjusted_means_pass2.parquet, mu 7.139, corr adj-raw 0.983
QUALITY.gate_example: adj_mean >= 7.5 or top quartile — state choice explicitly

UNDERRATEDNESS.question: Is better than expected from observable characteristics?
UNDERRATEDNESS.measure: residual vs Phase5/6 expectation (Q3b/OLS: log10(n_obs), year, weight, playtime, categories/mechanics — do NOT refit)
UNDERRATEDNESS.gate_example: residual >= +0.5 or top 10% per S3, stable across S3 vs S5 (historical SD 0.55 95th +0.87)
UNDERRATEDNESS.manual: which model S3 vs S5 and quantile; sensitivity must be shown

HIDDENNESS.question: Is sufficiently obscure / low popularity?
HIDDENNESS.measure: n_obs band + penetration_all / penetration_type_ge10 (Step7 exposure_proxy + 7C penetration)
HIDDENNESS.manual: band boundaries are project scope; Other penetration NA so n_obs only

AUDIENCE_SELECTION.question: Does observable selection materially threaten interpretation?
AUDIENCE_SELECTION.measure: stable_exposure / exposure_sensitive / insufficient_overlap via 7C rescaled rule + delta/ESS/max_w
AUDIENCE_SELECTION.gate: stable_exposure PASS; exposure_sensitive requires stronger broad-appeal; insufficient_overlap = unknown
AUDIENCE_SELECTION.manual: exposure_sensitive downgrade vs exclude is scope — framework chooses downgrade

BROAD_APPEAL_EVIDENCE.question: Is there positive evidence appeal extends beyond niche?
BROAD_APPEAL_EVIDENCE.measure: cross_audience diffs where n>=10 per side (specialist/volume), |diff|<0.30 and |z|<2 for >=2 splits, no diff>=0.50 p<0.05, plus truncated_delta check |trunc|<0.20
BROAD_APPEAL_EVIDENCE.manual: |diff|<0.30, z<2, n>=10, >=2 splits, |trunc|<0.20 are conventional disclosed thresholds

evidence_framework.minimum_for_hidden_gem: QUALITY ∧ UNDERRATEDNESS ∧ HIDDENNESS ∧ (stable_exposure with parity OR exposure_sensitive with stronger parity+trunc) — positive broad-appeal evidence mandatory; insufficient_overlap cannot be strong/plausible
interpretation_rules: do not call cult/hidden factually — hypotheses

buckets.1_high_quality_broad_observed: high quality + broad audience — adequate+stable, parity
buckets.2_high_quality_specialized_but_stable_cr: high quality + specialized audience but cross-audience parity — would be plausible if adequate
buckets.5_high_quality_popular_not_hidden: high quality + obviously popular — not hidden per project

cult_vs_hidden_examples.language_rule: do NOT call cult/hidden factually — tiers are hypotheses about observed evidence

strong_hidden_gem_evidence.requires: QUALITY pass ∧ UNDERRATEDNESS pass (stable S3/S5) ∧ HIDDENNESS pass ∧ stable_exposure (adequate+stable |delta|<0.20) ∧ >=2 cross-audience parities (|diff|<0.30 & |z|<2 & n>=10) ∧ |truncated_delta|<0.20 direction-consistent
strong_hidden_gem_evidence.interpretation: high quality, underrated, obscure, not selection-dependent, parity across materially different audiences

plausible_hidden_gem.requires: QUALITY∧UNDERRATEDNESS∧HIDDENNESS ∧ exposure_sensitive but survives stronger bar (>=2 parities & |trunc|<0.20)
plausible_hidden_gem.interpretation: sensitive to observable selection but corroborated breadth — plausible but closer scrutiny

niche_but_high_quality.requires: QUALITY (and HIDDENNESS) but exposure_sensitive without parity (<=1 parity or |diff|>=0.30 or trunc fails)
niche_but_high_quality.interpretation: excellent within niche, no BGG evidence it generalizes — not failure, not cult

insufficient_broad_appeal_evidence.requires: insufficient_overlap OR no cross-audience support (no split with n>=10) — regardless of other dimensions
insufficient_broad_appeal_evidence.interpretation: unknown — cannot tell broad vs niche; requires external data (plays/sales/time)

not_hidden_popular.requires: HIDDENNESS fail (large n_obs/penetration) regardless of others
not_hidden_popular.interpretation: high quality but obviously popular — bucket 5

open_manual_judgments.decision: T_q threshold for QUALITY (adj_mean cutoff, e.g., >=7.5 vs percentile)
which Phase5/6 expectation model (S3 category vs S5 band/decade vs both) and residual quantile (top 10%/5%/1%, >=+0.5)
HIDDENNESS bands: T_h n_obs cutoff (e.g., 1500) and penetration thresholds (all<0.05, type_ge10<0.10); Other relies on n_obs only
open_manual_judgments.caveat: Other per-game penetration not globally computed

open_manual_judgments.decision: broad-appeal parity thresholds: |diff|<0.30, |z|<2, n>=10 per side, >=2 splits, |truncated_delta|<0.20
exposure_sensitive gate: downgrade+stronger evidence (chosen) vs exclude (stricter variant)
open_manual_judgments.rationale: downgrade derived from research objective (need corroboration not auto-exclusion); stricter variant is defensible sensitivity

open_manual_judgments.decision: language: cult vs hidden tiers are communicative hypotheses, not facts

answers_to_five_questions.1_quality_estimator: No — adj_mean stays, prop_adj is sensitivity not quality. Six reasons: adequate 32.8% only, insufficient dominates niche 100% 18XX/52.9% Wargame, weights 156x larger, stabilized==raw rank, truncation attenuates, RF overconfident.
answers_to_five_questions.2_exposure_classes_screening: stable_exposure PASS, exposure_sensitive DOWNGRADE requiring >=2 cross-audience parities + trunc check else niche_but_high_quality, insufficient_overlap UNKNOWN (exclude from BGG-only hidden-gem, external validation needed). Rescaled thresholds: max_w 1740/8700, ESS 0.30/0.10, mean_p 0.015/0.005 justified from median max_w 1449 p95 7619 ESS 0.33 mean_p 0.027.
answers_to_five_questions.3_primary_vs_secondary: Primary: 7C overlap/ESS+delta (only reweighting measure, explains 62% beyond spec) and 7 cross-audience diffs n>=10 (only realized breadth test). Secondary: 7 composition (spec/TVD/herf/own/penetration) + 7C ESS/max_w/mean_p/trunc. Diagnostic-only: cat_related 0.993, RF variation, Other penetration NA, snapshot own.
answers_to_five_questions.4_minimum_for_plausible_hidden: QUALITY ∧ UNDERRATEDNESS (stable residual) ∧ HIDDENNESS (n_obs≤T_h & penetration) ∧ (stable_exposure with >=2 parities |diff|<0.30 OR exposure_sensitive with same but stronger) — positive broad-appeal mandatory; insufficient always insufficient.
answers_to_five_questions.5_methodological_vs_manual: Methodological: keep adj_mean, no imputation, screening not correction, overlap thresholds, primary mapping, insufficient=unknown, stabilized==raw. Manual: T_q, T_u model/quantile, hiddenness bands, parity cutoffs, downgrade vs exclude, tier labels/language.
